# CrackIt

> AI-powered interview and UPSC preparation platform with quizzes, company-specific practice, and personalized feedback.

CrackIt helps students and professionals prepare for technical interviews and the UPSC Civil Services Exam. The platform offers AI-generated quizzes across CS topics, company-specific question patterns, an AI tutor, UPSC syllabus coverage with previous-year cutoffs, and a leaderboard.
